programs.explicit_statement:
∀ (n : Nat) (header : Header) (available : UInt32) (v : LeanGo.Validate.Value),
  LeanGo.Validated.prog.run n "Wire16.classify"
        [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode header, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode available] =
      some v →
    v = LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Wire16.classify header available)

cases.statement:
LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Wire16.classify"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { flags := 0, length := 1 }, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 1] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Wire16.classify { flags := 0, length := 1 } 1))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Wire16.classify"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { flags := 1, length := 65535 }, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 4294967295] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Wire16.classify { flags := 1, length := 65535 } 4294967295))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Wire16.classify"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { flags := 255, length := 42435 }, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 2781043260] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Wire16.classify { flags := 255, length := 42435 } 2781043260))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Wire16.classify"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { flags := 165, length := 0 }, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 0] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Wire16.classify { flags := 165, length := 0 } 0))
